findings.failing_input: clampDateToToday rejects non-YYYY-MM-DD shapes via regex but DOES NOT reject impossible dates (2026-99-99 passes the regex). The author documented this in the test (line 76-81 of test): such dates are 'lex-greater than any real today → clamps to today'. The route-side dateValidation.isDate would reject them for /api/operator/* but here in the URL/Filters layer they're benignly clamped to today.
findings.expected: Documented behavior: benign clamp to today.
findings.actual: Works as documented — downstream SWR keys still receive valid YYYY-MM-DD.
findings.fix_sketch: None unless we want to centralize on dateValidation.isDate here too.
findings.regression_test_idea: Already covered by test 'impossible-date shape clamps to today'.

uncertainty_notes: HIGH-3 fix correctly closes the three classes of bad input that previously cascaded to 6 SWR keys: empty string, future date, inverted from>to. The null sentinel (instead of throwing) preserves mid-typing UX. swap-on-invert (collapse-to-single-day) is reasonable UX choice. PURE helpers — no side effects. Tests are thorough: 17 assertions across 4 describe blocks including boundary cases (year boundary, from===to, downstream-keys invariant).

test_coverage_gaps.suggested_fixture: clampDateToToday('2026-05-01', '') → null (or whatever the contract is); clampDateToToday('2026-05-01', undefined as any) — should not crash.
